name: Engineering contract draft and review controls
scope: Internal review to draft return transition
Action success and stage-specific failure messages

dataIsolation.guard: The transition is tenant-scoped and preserves immutable version content and existing review evidence.

changes: Add POST return-draft for internal-review versions
Project returned versions back to draft in the contract aggregate
Show explicit success messages for internal review, return, approval, and freeze
Show stage-specific draft-review errors and safe server logs
Use workflow state and latest-version evidence in the overview before signing
definitionOfDone: An internal-review version can return to draft without replacing its content
The returned version can generate a draft-review message again
Successful internal review is visibly confirmed
Draft-review failures identify the failed stage and do not send LINE
The overview no longer labels an existing version as unversioned
